stories.raw_headline: The Invisible Gap: Romanized Indic Generation Fails Where Automatic Metrics Succeed
stories.publisher: Madhu Sudhan Rao Beesetty, Surbhi Sharma, Devesh Maheshwari, Lokesh Meesala
stories.description: arXiv:2611.09085v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hundreds of millions of Indians communicate with digital systems in romanized Latin characters -- typing "aap kaise hain" rather than native script -- yet romanized Indic generation is absent from NLP benchmarks and evaluation frameworks. We demonstrate that automatic metrics (BGE-M3, BERTScore) systematically misrepresent the quality of romanized Hindi, Telugu, and Kannada generation.
